title: diff-forms-integration widget params
description: Integrating a 1-form over a 1-chain by pullback to the parameter interval. Pick a 1-form ω = P dx + Q dy and an oriented curve γ; the integral ∫_γ ω = ∫₀¹ [P(γ)x′ + Q(γ)y′] dt is the pullback γ*ω integrated over [0,1], shown as a Riemann sum with the form paired against the tangent γ′(t) at sample points (green where the pairing is positive, pink where negative). Reversing the orientation flips the sign — the ±1 coefficient on the chain — and the angle form ∮ = 2π around a loop enclosing the origin previews de Rham.
